attributes.name: Hawkmoon Bow
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d6+2. If proficient with weapons or you have the Elf trait, add another 1d6. 

If proficient with weapons, discard this card to add 1d4 to a combat check by a character at another location.
